youtube_short.title: That 'Buy Now' Button Cost You $1,300
title_alternatives: How Amazon's Checkout Design Drains Your Wallet
The $1,300 One-Click Patent Nobody Warned You About
youtube_short.description:
Amazon patented one-click ordering in 1999 and defended it in court for 20 years — because removing each checkout step makes you spend 12% more. The average American racks up $1,300 a year in impulse purchases thanks to frictionless checkout design. Apps deliberately make confirm buttons huge and cancel buttons tiny, and 68% of subscribers pay 3 extra months because cancellation is a maze. Here's how to add friction back and keep your $1,300. #PersonalFinance #MoneyPsychology #SaveMoney

Follow for daily money psychology breakdowns.
